mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_data_database WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM paiflow_data_database WHERE space_id=#{space} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10001
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_data_database SET name=#{name},description=#{description},avatar_icon=#{avatarIcon},avatar_color=#{avatarColor},deleted=#{deleted},revision=revision+1,update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM paiflow_data_table WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM paiflow_data_table WHERE db_id=#{db} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1001
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_data_table SET name=#{name},description=#{description},fields_json=#{fieldsJson},deleted=#{deleted},revision=revision+1,update_time=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT id,row_json AS rowJson FROM paiflow_data_row WHERE table_id=#{table} AND exec_env=#{env} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paiflow_data_row WHERE table_id=#{table} AND exec_env=#{env}
mapper.update: UPDATE paiflow_data_row SET row_json=#{json} WHERE table_id=#{table} AND exec_env=#{env} AND id=#{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM paiflow_data_row WHERE table_id=#{table} AND exec_env=#{env} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paiflow_workflow_version v,JSON_TABLE(v.resource_snapshots_json,'$.*' COLUMNS(kind VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.kind',db BIGINT PATH '$.legacyDbId' NULL ON EMPTY)) refs WHERE refs.kind='database' AND refs.db=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paiflow_workflow_version v,JSON_TABLE(v.resource_snapshots_json,'$.*' COLUMNS(kind VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.kind',NESTED PATH '$.tables.*' COLUMNS(tb BIGINT PATH '$.tableId' NULL ON EMPTY))) refs WHERE refs.kind='database' AND refs.tb=#{id}
SELECT request_hash AS requestHash,response_json AS responseJson FROM paiflow_data_request WHERE run_id=#{run} AND attempt=#{attempt} AND request_key_hash=#{key}
